title: Pod CrashLoopBackOff due to OOMKilled on recommendation-service
description: A batch job inside the pod (ModelRefreshJob) spikes memory in short bursts, exceeding the container limit and triggering repeated OOM kills (exit code 137), leaving the pod in CrashLoopBackOff. The OOMKilled event + exit code directly prove the kill mechanism; they do not by themselves prove the batch job is the only contributor. Remediation guidance is in the OOMKilled / CrashLoopBackOff runbook, and the exact spike source needs heap-dump verification.
